purpose: Teach: 社説/説教/白書/争点/若年/文学部/一帯/操業

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、新聞の、本気で、絶対、社説、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, the way you handled the newspaper editorial in your paper was really impressive.
lines.style: Warm, genuinely impressed. Leans forward slightly. Measured pace, sincere—not flattering. Genuine recognition of effort.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。宗教家の、本気で、絶対、説教、絶対、伝統、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I really tried to engage deeply with how religious figures present their teachings in the literature.
lines.style: Respectful, earnest. Slight pause before speaking, choosing words carefully. Genuine gratitude, not performative. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 政府の、本気で、絶対、白書、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And your analysis of government white papers showed real depth.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective tone. Slight nod. Slower pace—considering what she's saying. Recognition of scholarly work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。選挙の、本気で、絶対、争点、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to really examine how election issues are framed in academic discourse.
lines.style: Focused, engaged. Speaks with quiet conviction about the research. No hesitation—she knows what she did. Respectful but confident.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、若年、絶対、層の、絶対、政治、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you connected that to young voters' political engagement was particularly thoughtful.
lines.style: Engaged, warm. Eyes light up slightly. Pace picks up just a touch—this is what she wanted to see. Recognition of critical thinking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。大学、本気で、絶対、文学部、絶対、の、絶対、伝統、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I drew a lot from the literary tradition in our university's literature department and really tried to apply that lens.
lines.style: Earnest, focused. Sits up slightly straighter. Takes the compliment seriously—explains her thinking without over-explaining. Genuine pride in the work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地域、本気で、絶対、一帯、絶対、の、絶対、文化、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your exploration of how cultural traditions shape regional development was exceptionally clear.
lines.style: Warm appreciation in the voice. Genuine, unhurried. Acknowledges the intellectual work underneath. Teacher voice—encouraging without being patronizing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。工場の、本気で、絶対、操業、絶対、影響、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I examined how factory operations in that region have influenced cultural practices, and I'm really grateful for the opportunity to research it.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. Voice steady and grounded. Sincere thanks—means it, not just receiving praise. Ends with genuine relief and closure.
